payload.notes:
Gemma 4 26B A4B instruction Q8 GGUF on one Intel Arc Pro B70 via llama.cpp SYCL/XPU. Sustained-decode shape: BENCH_PROMPT_MODE=long produced actual 75 prompt tokens and exactly 512 generated tokens on every repeat. Validation: standard chat canary 96 repeats x 4 cases = 384/384 pass with REASONING=off. Throughput uses server-reported usage.completion_tokens after TTFT. This run repeats the official Gemma MTP draft GGUF n=3 configuration with --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 3, f16 draft KV, and the bmg-g31 AOT llama.cpp SYCL build. It supersedes the prior approved AOT n=3 draft-MTP sustained-decode result at 47.92204795174685 tok/s. Evidence: https://github.com/steveseguin/b70-optimization-lab/blob/main/results/gemma4-26b-a4b-q8-b70/README.md and data/gemma4-q8-gpu0-mtp-n3-aot-repeat-long-deep-20260623T0353/summary.json.
